page: Microsoft Azure DC64as_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCasv6 server family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 AMD processor architecture, managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met using external volumes, though the instance is designated as Premium Storage capable. There are zero GPUs integrated into this configuration, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-core ratio offer a predictable resource density for multi-threaded workloads. The server is designed for general-purpose workloads, enterprise applications, and multi-threaded processing tasks that require dedicated CPU resources but do not demand local NVMe storage or hardware acceleration.
